bio_text: Ricardo Uzcategui is the Co-Founder, CTO, and COO of Pangian, a global remote talent platform connecting professionals across 150+ countries, which he has been building since 2016. A Techstars mentor and TED AI alum based in San Francisco, he operates at the intersection of AI/ML, Web3, and the future of work, with a core conviction that geography should never be a barrier to career opportunity. He actively helps startups grow and advises on remote hiring, talent ecosystems, and early-stage company building.
